regions.today: Cloudy periods with the odd spot of light rain or drizzle at first today, Friday, but long spells of sunshine will develop this afternoon. Highest temperatures of 19 to 23 degrees in light to moderate westerly breezes.
regions.tonight: Dry with variable cloud and clear spells at first tonight. Cloud will build from the west overnight patchy rain and drizzle possible towards morning. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 13 degrees with a few mist and fog patches forming in the light southerly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Some sunny spells tomorrow, Saturday, but a good deal of cloud overall with occasional rain or showers, some possibly heavy in the north of province later. Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees in light to moderate southerly breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Friday. High in any sunshine on Saturday, otherwise low.
